checks.name: JSON examples syntactically valid
checks.scope: Python JSON syntax only; deliberate digest placeholder must be replaced, not a claim Rust/crypto accepted this literal.

verified_by_source: Server/client flat schema_version1 JSON, broker actual nonzero UID equality, client logical server_id and Peer shape.
Dedicated UID disjoint from interactive UIDs, secure Native/USBFS pools disjoint from legacy pools and each other; logical import rule uses exact stable key.

DER CA/chain public root-owned/nonwritable parents, secret root-or-broker0600 regular/single-link protected read, no automatic permissions bypass. PKCS8 is a valid recommended subset of accepted DER key formats.
Mandatory TLS1.3+mTLS+ALPN, leaf pin adds per-device authority after standard chain verification.
Secure-server backend options and Native-only secure-transport build do not require Rust device engine; full all-features build provides virtual/usbfs/native.
Actual secure-discover/attach, native-pending --after and native-reconcile spellings; helper defaults Native journal /var/lib/rustusb/native.
Actual connected/disconnected schema and cleanup_verified emitted only after real handle.close response, output backpressure may prevent final event; source does not treat OS EOF as cleanup receipt.
Documentation explicitly leaves new end-to-end QEMU acceptance pending and retains hardware/ISO/general recovery/Phase3 gates.

clarifications.recommendation: Say 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits, matching CertificatePin::from_hex. The supplied openssl command already emits lowercase so the documented command works.

clarifications.phrase: Native publishes the actual pre-export descriptor snapshot; it reports current configuration and driver state separately.
clarifications.recommendation: State current CLI snapshot is published registration metadata plus accepting_imports, not a current configuration/driver report; current phase is retained in helper receipts and should be independently observed via sysfs/device inspection.

not_executed: No certificate deployment or filesystem ownership proof.
repository_changes: None by this reviewer; reports only /tmp.
